# Part A

## Step 1. INITIAL FILTERING & SCREEN TIME CLEANING

```{r}
# Preserves all N = 29,400 observations per survey estimation rules
nhanes_clean <- master_raw %>%
  mutate(
    # --- Derived Variables & Weights ---
    WTMEC6YR = WTMEC2YR / 3,
    tv_hours = case_when(
      PAQ710 == 8 ~ 0,
      PAQ710 %in% c(77, 99) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(PAQ710)
    ),
    comp_hours = case_when(
      PAQ715 == 8 ~ 0,
      PAQ715 %in% c(77, 99) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(PAQ715)
    ),
    total_screen_time = tv_hours + comp_hours,
    parent_edu = case_when(
      # Check 2013-2016 Waves (DMDHREDU) using text matching or numeric codes
      !is.na(DMDHREDU) & (as.character(DMDHREDU) %in% c("1", "2", "Less than 9th grade", "9-11th grade (Includes 12th grade with no diploma)") | as.numeric(DMDHREDU) %in% c(1, 2)) ~ "Less than High School",
      !is.na(DMDHREDU) & (as.character(DMDHREDU) %in% c("3", "4", "High school graduate/GED or equivalent", "Some college or AA degree") | as.numeric(DMDHREDU) %in% c(3, 4)) ~ "High School / Some College",
      !is.na(DMDHREDU) & (as.character(DMDHREDU) %in% c("5", "College graduate or above") | as.numeric(DMDHREDU) == 5) ~ "College Grad or Above",
      
      # Check 2017-2018 Wave (DMDHREDZ) using text matching or numeric codes
      !is.na(DMDHREDZ) & (as.character(DMDHREDZ) %in% c("1", "Less than high school graduate") | as.numeric(DMDHREDZ) == 1) ~ "Less than High School",
      !is.na(DMDHREDZ) & (as.character(DMDHREDZ) %in% c("2", "High school graduate/GED or some college") | as.numeric(DMDHREDZ) == 2) ~ "High School / Some College",
      !is.na(DMDHREDZ) & (as.character(DMDHREDZ) %in% c("3", "College graduate or above") | as.numeric(DMDHREDZ) == 3) ~ "College Grad or Above",
      
      .default = NA_character_
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("Less than High School", "High School / Some College", "College Grad or Above")),
    
    age_band = floor(RIDEXAGM / 12)
  )
```

## Step 2. PHASE 1: PROTOCOL ELIGIBILITY

```{r}

nhanes_clean <- nhanes_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # verifies participant attended a MEC exam (has a valid exam age and a positive MEC weight)
    flag_mec = ifelse(!is.na(RIDEXAGM) & WTMEC2YR > 0, 1, 0),
    
    #verifies age range criteria (8-17 years)
flag_age = ifelse(flag_mec == 1 & RIDAGEYR >= 8 & RIDAGEYR <= 17, 1, 0),
  
  #verifies eligible for dexa (includes valid and invalid results)
flag_dexa_eligible = ifelse(flag_age == 1, 1, 0),
  
  #defines baseline "eligible sample" (ie. steps 1-4 of fig 1 flow diagram)
subpop_eligible = ifelse(flag_dexa_eligible == 1, 1, 0))

```

```{r}
## Step 2. PHASE 1: PROTOCOL ELIGIBILITY ##
nhanes_clean <- nhanes_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # verifies participant attended a MEC exam (has a valid exam age and a positive MEC weight)
    flag_mec = ifelse(!is.na(RIDEXAGM) & WTMEC2YR > 0, 1, 0),
    
    #verifies age range criteria (8-17 years)
flag_age = ifelse(flag_mec == 1 & RIDAGEYR >= 8 & RIDAGEYR <= 17, 1, 0),
  
  #verifies eligible for dexa (includes valid and invalid results)
flag_dexa_eligible = ifelse(flag_age == 1, 1, 0),
  
  #defines baseline "eligible sample" (ie. steps 1-4 of fig 1 flow diagram)
subpop_eligible = ifelse(flag_dexa_eligible == 1, 1, 0))
```

## Step 3. PHASE 2: MISSINGNESS EXCLUSIONS

```{r}

nhanes_clean <- nhanes_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # Starts from eligible sample (subpop_eligible == 1) and removes missing/invalid DEXA scans
    flag_valid_dexa = ifelse(subpop_eligible == 1 & !is.na(DXDSTBMD), 1, 0),
    
    # REmoves participants missing standing height data
    flag_valid_height = ifelse(flag_valid_dexa == 1 & !is.na(BMXHT), 1, 0),
    
    # Removes participants missing TV/computer screen time data
    flag_valid_screen = ifelse(flag_valid_height == 1 & !is.na(total_screen_time), 1, 0),
    
    # Removes participants missing child food security questionnaire data
    flag_valid_fsq = ifelse(flag_valid_screen == 1 & !is.na(FSDCH), 1, 0),
    
    # Removes participants missing race/ethnicity
    flag_valid_race = ifelse(flag_valid_fsq == 1 & !is.na(RIDRETH3), 1, 0),
    
    # Removes participants missing household poverty level / income ratio
    flag_valid_pir = ifelse(flag_valid_race == 1 & !is.na(INDFMPIR), 1, 0),
    
    # Removes participants missing parent education level
    flag_valid_edu = ifelse(flag_valid_pir == 1 & !is.na(parent_edu), 1, 0),

    # Defines the final group with ZERO missing data across all key study variables
    subpop1= ifelse(flag_valid_edu == 1, 1, 0),
    
    #subpop (DEXA valid only) for REFERENCE
    subpop = ifelse(flag_valid_dexa == 1, 1, 0))

```

## Step 4. PRINT PHASE 1 COUNTS (eligibility)

```{r}
cat("=========================================================\n")
cat("      PHASE 1: PROTOCOL ELIGIBILITY COUNTS              \n")

# Total starting sample across all 3 survey waves
cat("Total NHANES 2013-2018 Combined Sample:    ", nrow(nhanes_clean), "\n\n")

# Exclusions & remaining count for MEC attendance
cat("Excluded: Did not attend MEC exam:        -", sum(nhanes_clean$flag_mec == 0), "\n")
cat("  Attended MEC Exam:                       ", sum(nhanes_clean$flag_mec == 1), "\n\n")

# Exclusions & remaining count for Age 8-17 (checked among MEC attendees)
cat("Excluded: Outside age range 8–17 years:   -", sum(nhanes_clean$flag_mec == 1 & nhanes_clean$flag_age == 0), "\n")
cat("  Aged 8–17 years:                         ", sum(nhanes_clean$flag_age == 1), "\n\n")

# Exclusions & final count for DEXA protocol eligibility
cat("Excluded: Ineligible for DEXA protocol:   -", sum(nhanes_clean$flag_age == 1 & nhanes_clean$flag_dexa_eligible == 0), "\n")
cat("---------------------------------------------------------\n")

# Total target eligible subpopulation (Step 2 output)
cat("TARGET ELIGIBLE SAMPLE (subpop_eligible):  ", sum(nhanes_clean$subpop_eligible == 1), "\n")
cat("=========================================================\n")
```

## Step by step exclusion counts for flow diagram

```{r}

# Starting pool: Target Eligible Sample (subpop_eligible)
step0_eligible <- nhanes_clean %>% filter(subpop_eligible == 1) # N = 5347

# Step 1: Missing DEXA
excl_dexa <- step0_eligible %>% filter(is.na(DXDSTBMD))
step1_dexa <- step0_eligible %>% filter(!is.na(DXDSTBMD))

# Step 2: Missing Height 
excl_height <- step1_dexa %>% filter(is.na(BMXHT))
step2_height <- step1_dexa %>% filter(!is.na(BMXHT))

# Step 3: Missing Screen Time  
excl_screen <- step2_height %>% filter(is.na(total_screen_time))
step3_screen <- step2_height %>% filter(!is.na(total_screen_time))

# Step 4: Missing Food Security  
excl_fsq <- step3_screen %>% filter(is.na(FSDCH))
step4_fsq <- step3_screen %>% filter(!is.na(FSDCH))

# Step 5: Missing Race/Ethnicity  
excl_race <- step4_fsq %>% filter(is.na(RIDRETH3))
step5_race <- step4_fsq %>% filter(!is.na(RIDRETH3))

# Step 6: Missing PIR 
excl_pir <- step5_race %>% filter(is.na(INDFMPIR))
step6_pir <- step5_race %>% filter(!is.na(INDFMPIR))

# Step 7: Missing Parent Education 
excl_edu <- step6_pir %>% filter(is.na(parent_edu))
step7_final <- step6_pir %>% filter(!is.na(parent_edu)) # Should equal 3997!

# Print the waterfall subtractions
cat("Step 1 Excluded (DEXA):", nrow(excl_dexa), "\n")
cat("Step 2 Excluded (Height):", nrow(excl_height), "\n")
cat("Step 3 Excluded (Screen Time):", nrow(excl_screen), "\n")
cat("Step 4 Excluded (Food Security):", nrow(excl_fsq), "\n")
cat("Step 5 Excluded (Race):", nrow(excl_race), "\n")
cat("Step 6 Excluded (PIR):", nrow(excl_pir), "\n")
cat("Step 7 Excluded (Education):", nrow(excl_edu), "\n")

total_exclusions <- nrow(excl_dexa) + nrow(excl_height) + nrow(excl_screen) + 
                   nrow(excl_fsq) + nrow(excl_race) + nrow(excl_pir) + nrow(excl_edu)

cat("TOTAL EXCLUSIONS:", total_exclusions, "\n")  
cat("REMAINING ANALYTIC SAMPLE:", nrow(step7_final), "\n")  

#after DEXA, Screen Time, Height, and Food Security are already validated (flag_valid_fsq == 1), this code gives counts for how many ppl are missing race/eth data, FPL data, and parent ed data (ie. not mutually exclusive)
#race/eth
sum(nhanes_clean$flag_valid_fsq == 1 & 
    (is.na(nhanes_clean$RIDRETH3)))
#FPL
sum(nhanes_clean$flag_valid_fsq == 1 & 
    (is.na(nhanes_clean$INDFMPIR)))
#parent ed
sum(nhanes_clean$flag_valid_fsq == 1 & 
    (is.na(nhanes_clean$parent_edu)))
```

## Calculation of Weighted Quartiles

```{r}
## Calculated weighted quantiles for exposure
# Temporary survey design to extract weighted quantiles within subpop
temp_design <- svydesign(
  id = ~SDMVPSU,
  strata = ~SDMVSTRA,
  weights = ~WTMEC6YR,
  nest = TRUE,
  data = nhanes_clean) 

#set subpop equal to our analytic sample
subpop_temp <- subset(temp_design, subpop1 ==1)

# Extract weighted 25th, 50th, and 75th percentiles of total screen time
screen_quantiles <- svyquantile(
  ~total_screen_time,
  design = subpop_temp,
  quantiles = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Cutpoints
q25 <- as.numeric(screen_quantiles$total_screen_time[1, "quantile"])
q50 <- as.numeric(screen_quantiles$total_screen_time[2, "quantile"])
q75 <- as.numeric(screen_quantiles$total_screen_time[3, "quantile"])

print(screen_quantiles)
```

## Creation of Variables

```{r}
#create new var for screen time quartiles and set as factor
nhanes_newvars <- nhanes_clean %>%
  mutate(
    screen_quart = case_when(
      total_screen_time <= q25 ~ "Q1",
      total_screen_time >q25 & total_screen_time <= q50 ~ "Q2",
      total_screen_time >q50 & total_screen_time <= q75 ~ "Q3",
      total_screen_time >q75 ~ "Q4",
    .default = NA_character_) %>%
      factor(levels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4")))

#unweighted sample size per quartile, restricted to subpop1: >4,600 in each
table(nhanes_newvars$screen_quart[nhanes_newvars$subpop1 == 1], useNA = "always")

#create new var for FPL categories
nhanes_newvars <- nhanes_newvars %>%
  mutate(
    fpl_cat = case_when(
      INDFMPIR < 1.00 ~ "Poverty (< 100% PIR)",
      INDFMPIR >= 1.00 & INDFMPIR <= 1.30 ~ "Near Poverty (100-130% PIR)",
      INDFMPIR >= 1.31 & INDFMPIR < 2.00 ~ "Low-Middle Income (131-199% PIR)",
      INDFMPIR >= 2.00 & INDFMPIR <= 3.50 ~ "High-Middle Income (200-350% PIR)",
      INDFMPIR > 3.50 ~ "High Income (> 350% PIR)",
      .default = NA_character_
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("Poverty (< 100% PIR)", "Near Poverty (100-130% PIR)", "Low-Middle Income (131-199% PIR)", "High-Middle Income (200-350% PIR)", "High Income (> 350% PIR)")))

#create new categorical age var for T1
nhanes_newvars <- nhanes_newvars %>%
  mutate(
    age_cat = case_when(
      RIDAGEYR >= 8  & RIDAGEYR < 13  ~ "8–12 years",
      RIDAGEYR >= 13 & RIDAGEYR <= 17 ~ "12–17 years",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("8–12 years", "12–17 years")))

# check to make sure no missing values for z scores 
sum(nhanes_clean$subpop1 == 1 & is.na(nhanes_clean$z_haz_adj))
#Create categorical version of TBLH BMD z-scores for prevalence estimates
nhanes_newvars <- nhanes_newvars %>%
  mutate(
    bmd_z_cat = case_when(
      z_haz_adj <= -2.0 ~ "Low TBLH BMD",
      z_haz_adj > -2.0 ~ "Normal TBLH BMD",
      .default = NA_character_
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("Normal TBLH BMD", "Low TBLH BMD")))

#confirm factors in nhanes_newvars
nhanes_newvars %>% 
  select(RIAGENDR, RIDRETH3, fpl_cat, screen_quart, bmd_z_cat, FSDCH, INDFMPIR, age_cat) %>% 
  glimpse()
```

## Survey Design & Analytic Subpopulation

```{r}
## Primary survey design
nhanes_design_full <- svydesign(
  id = ~SDMVPSU,
  strata = ~SDMVSTRA,
  weights = ~WTMEC6YR,
  nest = TRUE,
  data = nhanes_newvars)

# Isolating analytic subpop
subpop_design <- subset(nhanes_design_full, subpop1 == 1)

```

## Central Tendency 

```{r}

## Central Tendency ## 
#Estimate the mean and central tendency of BMD correcting for stratified sampling and survey weights. 
## correcting for stratified sampling and survey weights
svymean(~z_haz_adj, design = subpop_design)


#Estimating the mean and central tendency of BMD by screen time quartiles
svyby(formula = ~z_haz_adj, 
      by = ~factor(screen_quart), 
      design = subpop_design, 
      FUN = svymean, 
      keep.var = TRUE)

#Estimating the mean and central tendency of BMD by screen time quartiles & SEX
svyby(formula = ~z_haz_adj, 
      by = ~factor(screen_quart), 
      design = subset(subpop_design, RIAGENDR =="Male"), # by sex male
      FUN = svymean, 
      keep.var = TRUE)

svyby(formula = ~z_haz_adj, 
      by = ~factor(screen_quart), 
      design = subset(subpop_design, RIAGENDR =="Female"), # by sex female
      FUN = svymean, 
      keep.var = TRUE)


```

## Table 1 Male

```{r}
## Table 1 based on course suggestion ##


#recode names of values for FSDCH variable
nhanes_newvars <- nhanes_newvars %>%
  mutate(
    fsdch_2cat = fct_collapse(
      FSDCH,
      "High/Marginal Food Security" = c(
        "CH full or marginal food security: 0", 
        "CH marginal food security: 1"),
      "Low/Very Low Food Security" = c(
        "CH low food security: 2-4", 
        "CH very low food security: 5-8")))

#set levels for fsdch_2cat - high/marginal as ref
nhanes_newvars <- nhanes_newvars %>%
  mutate(
    fsdch_2cat = factor(
      fsdch_2cat,
      levels = c(
        "High/Marginal Food Security",
        "Low/Very Low Food Security")))

# Verify the recode worked
table(nhanes_newvars$fsdch_2cat, useNA = "ifany")
table(nhanes_newvars$FSDCH, useNA = "ifany")


# creating labels for variable names to display on Table 1
# cannot label the stratification lables or else the code won't work for the Table
label(nhanes_newvars$RIDRETH3) <- "Race/Ethnicity"
label(nhanes_newvars$fpl_cat) <- "Household Poverty Income Ratio (PIR)"
label(nhanes_newvars$parent_edu) <- "Parent Education"
label(nhanes_newvars$RIDAGEYR) <- "Age (Years)"
label(nhanes_newvars$fsdch_2cat) <- "Food Security Status"
label(nhanes_newvars$age_cat) <- "Age Group"


#check results
tabyl(nhanes_newvars, fsdch_2cat)

#establish survey design
nhanes_design_full <- svydesign(
  id = ~SDMVPSU,
  strata = ~SDMVSTRA,
  weights = ~WTMEC6YR,
  nest = TRUE,
  data = nhanes_newvars)

# Isolating analytic subpop
subpop_design <- subset(nhanes_design_full, subpop1 == 1)

# Subset designs by sex
design_males   <- subset(subpop_design, RIAGENDR %in% c("Male", "male", 1))
design_females <- subset(subpop_design, RIAGENDR %in% c("Female", "female", 2))

#Build table 1 - males
t1_male <- tbl_svysummary(
  data = design_males,
  by = screen_quart,
  include = c(RIDAGEYR, RIDRETH3, fpl_cat, parent_edu, fsdch_2cat),
  missing = "no",
  statistic = list(
    all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({mean.std.error})", # using Mean and SE for all contin vars
    all_categorical() ~ "{n_unweighted} ({p}%)") # using unweighted counts and wtd % for all cat vars
  ) %>%
  add_n("{N_miss_unweighted} ({p_miss})") %>% # adding a column for Missing unwtd counts and wtdN(these are not variables; they are part of the function) %
  modify_header(n ~ "**Missing n (%)**") %>% #creating the label for the header of Missing
  modify_spanning_header(all_stat_cols() ~ "**Daily Screen Time Quartile**") %>%  #labeling the stratification var
  modify_header(stat_1 ~ "**Q1**<br>N = {n_unweighted}") %>% #labeling strat columns & getting unwted n
  modify_header(stat_2 ~ "**Q2**<br>N = {n_unweighted}") %>%
  modify_header(stat_3 ~ "**Q3**<br>N = {n_unweighted}") %>%
  modify_header(stat_4 ~ "**Q4**<br>N = {n_unweighted}") %>%
  modify_caption(caption = "Table 1. NHANES 2013-2018 distribution of characteristics among U.S male children 8 to 17 years of age (n = 2,044) according to quartiles of average daily screen time ") %>%
  #remove default footnote and superscript
modify_footnote(all_stat_cols() ~ NA) %>%
  as_gt() %>%
  gt::tab_source_note(
    source_note = "Continuous variables are presented as weighted mean (SE) and categorical variables are presented as unweighted n (weighted %). Abbreviations: NHANES, National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey; SE, Standard Error; PIR, Poverty Income Ratio."
  )

t1_male


```

## Combined Table 1
```{r}
## Make combined table 1 stratified by screen time quartiles AND sex ##
# Male Table to combine
t1_male_comb <- tbl_svysummary(
  data = design_males,
  by = screen_quart,
  include = c(total_screen_time, RIDAGEYR, age_cat, RIDRETH3, fpl_cat, parent_edu, fsdch_2cat),
  missing = "no",
  statistic = list(
    total_screen_time ~ "{mean} ({mean.std.error})",
    all_continuous()  ~ "{mean} ({mean.std.error})",
    all_categorical() ~ "{n_unweighted} ({p}%)"
  ),
  digits = list(
    all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1),  
    all_continuous()  ~ c(2, 2)
  ),
  label = list(
    total_screen_time ~ "Screen Time (Hours/Day)"
  )
) %>%
  modify_header(stat_1 ~ "**Q1**<br>(&le; 4 hours)<br>N = {n_unweighted} ({style_number(p * 100, digits = 1)}%)") %>%
  modify_header(stat_2 ~ "**Q2**<br>(> 4 hours to &le; 6 hours)<br>N = {n_unweighted} ({style_number(p * 100, digits = 1)}%)") %>%
  modify_header(stat_3 ~ "**Q3**<br>(> 6 hours to &le; 9 hours)<br>N = {n_unweighted} ({style_number(p * 100, digits = 1)}%)") %>%
  modify_header(stat_4 ~ "**Q4**<br>(> 9 hours)<br>N = {n_unweighted} ({style_number(p * 100, digits = 1)}%)") %>%
  modify_footnote(all_stat_cols() ~ NA)

# Female Table to combine
t1_female_comb <- tbl_svysummary(
  data = design_females,
  by = screen_quart,
  include = c(total_screen_time, RIDAGEYR, age_cat, RIDRETH3, fpl_cat, parent_edu, fsdch_2cat),
  missing = "no",
  statistic = list(
    total_screen_time ~ "{mean} ({mean.std.error})",
    all_continuous()  ~ "{mean} ({mean.std.error})",
    all_categorical() ~ "{n_unweighted} ({p}%)"
  ),
  digits = list(
    all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1),
    all_continuous()  ~ c(2, 2)
  ),
  label = list(
    total_screen_time ~ "Screen Time (Hours/Day)"
  )
) %>%
  modify_header(stat_1 ~ "**Q1**<br>(&le; 4 hours)<br>N = {n_unweighted} ({style_number(p * 100, digits = 1)}%)") %>%
  modify_header(stat_2 ~ "**Q2**<br>(> 4 hours to &le; 6 hours)<br>N = {n_unweighted} ({style_number(p * 100, digits = 1)}%)") %>%
  modify_header(stat_3 ~ "**Q3**<br>(> 6 hours to &le; 9 hours)<br>N = {n_unweighted} ({style_number(p * 100, digits = 1)}%)") %>%
  modify_header(stat_4 ~ "**Q4**<br>(> 9 hours)<br>N = {n_unweighted} ({style_number(p * 100, digits = 1)}%)") %>%
  modify_footnote(all_stat_cols() ~ NA)

# Combined Table
t1_combined <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(t1_male_comb, t1_female_comb),
  tab_spanner = c("**Males (n = 2,044)**", "**Females (n = 1,953)**")
) %>%
  modify_caption(
    caption = "Table 1. NHANES 2013-2018 distribution of characteristics among U.S. children 8 to 17 years of age stratified by sex and daily screen time quartiles"
  ) %>%
  as_gt() %>%
  gt::tab_source_note(
    source_note = "Continuous variables are presented as weighted mean (SE) and categorical variables are presented as unweighted n (weighted %). Abbreviations: NHANES, National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey; SE, Standard Error; PIR, Poverty Income Ratio."
  )

t1_combined

## Adding a combined column AND physical acivity var to Table 1 
## Overall Table (Total column)
t1_total_comb <- tbl_svysummary(
  data = subpop_design,   # your full survey design object
  include = c(total_screen_time, RIDAGEYR, age_cat, RIDRETH3, fpl_cat, parent_edu, fsdch_2cat),
  missing = "no",
  statistic = list(
    total_screen_time ~ "{mean} ({mean.std.error})",
    all_continuous()  ~ "{mean} ({mean.std.error})",
    all_categorical() ~ "{n_unweighted} ({p}%)"
  ),
  digits = list(
    all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1),
    all_continuous()  ~ c(2, 2)
  ),
  label = list(
    total_screen_time ~ "Screen Time (Hours/Day)"
  )
) %>%
  modify_header(
    label ~ "**Variable**",
    stat_0 ~ "**Total**<br>N = {n_unweighted}"
  ) %>%
  modify_footnote(all_stat_cols() ~ NA)


## Merge all three tables
t1_combined_full <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(t1_total_comb, t1_male_comb, t1_female_comb),
  tab_spanner = c("**Total**", "**Males (n = 2,044)**", "**Females (n = 1,953)**")
) %>%
  modify_caption(
    caption = "Table 1. NHANES 2013-2018 distribution of characteristics among U.S. children 8 to 17 years of age stratified by sex and daily screen time quartiles"
  ) %>%
  as_gt() %>%
  gt::tab_source_note(
    source_note = "Continuous variables are presented as weighted mean (SE) and categorical variables are presented as unweighted n (weighted %). Abbreviations: NHANES, National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey; SE, Standard Error; PIR, Poverty Income Ratio."
  )

t1_combined_full
```

## Assess Missingness

```{r}
label(nhanes_newvars$RIAGENDR) <- "Gender"

# Variables needed for analysis.
req_vars <- c("RIDAGEYR", "RIAGENDR", "age_cat", "RIDRETH3", "fpl_cat", "parent_edu", "fsdch_2cat", "screen_quart", "DXDSTBMD", "BMXHT")

# Filter to subpop_eligible == 1 
eval_missing_data <- nhanes_newvars %>%
  filter(subpop_eligible == 1) %>% 
  mutate(
    analytic_status = ifelse(
      subpop1 == 1, 
      "Analytic Sample (Included)", 
      "Missing Data (Excluded)"))

# Create Survey Design Object for new eval_missing_data daataset
design_missing_eval <- svydesign(
  id = ~SDMVPSU,
  strata = ~SDMVSTRA,
  weights = ~WTMEC6YR,  
  nest = TRUE,
  data = eval_missing_data)

# Generate descriptive table
table_missingness <- tbl_svysummary(
  data = design_missing_eval,
  by = analytic_status,
  include = c(RIAGENDR, RIDAGEYR, age_cat, RIDRETH3, fpl_cat, parent_edu, fsdch_2cat, BMXHT, screen_quart),
  statistic = list(
    all_continuous()  ~ "{mean} ({mean.std.error})",
    all_categorical() ~ "{n_unweighted} ({p}%)"
  ),
  missing = "no"
) %>%
  add_p() %>%
  modify_header(stat_1 ~ "**Analytic Sample (Included)**<br>n = {n_unweighted}") %>%
  modify_header(stat_2 ~ "**Missing Data (Excluded)**<br>n = {n_unweighted}") %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Characteristic**") %>%
  modify_spanning_header(all_stat_cols() ~ "**Inclusion Status**") %>%
  modify_caption(
    caption = "Descriptive Comparison of Eligible Participants Included in Analytic Sample vs. Excluded Due to Missing Data"
  ) %>%
  modify_footnote(all_stat_cols() ~ NA) %>%
  as_gt() %>%
  gt::tab_source_note(
    source_note = "Continuous variables presented as weighted Mean (SE); categorical variables presented as unweighted n (weighted %). P-values calculated using design-adjusted Chi-square tests and t-tests."
  )

table_missingness

#save table_missingness
gt::gtsave(table_missingness, filename = "table_missingness.png") #save male as png

```
